description: Three systems discussed by Venditti24 Fig. 2, transcribed from their original observational papers. Not a complete survey or three confirmed Pop III detections.
epoch: 2023-2024 literature; later Hebe measurements are separate inputs

records.locator: Table 1 and its He II footnote; sections 3 and 4 (publisher version)
records.component: entire lensed arclet A+B, elongated extraction aperture
records.dust_treatment: No additional correction; negligible extinction assumed in comparison
records.notes: Author adopts non-detection: tentative peak is blueshifted by about 1200 km/s. Limit is 1 sigma noise, NOT tentative flux plus noise. Lensing uncertainty omits dominant possible systematics. This arclet is not a UV-bright whole galaxy.

records.locator: Tables 1 and 3, section 4.4 Eq. (2), section 5.2 and Table 5
records.component: component A targeted by NIRSpec MSA, not A+B combined
records.dust_treatment: Table 3 uses stellar Av=0.12 +/- 0.04, Calzetti law; nebular Av has only an upper limit
records.notes: Do not divide intrinsic flux or published luminosity by mu again. Broad F140W rest UV magnitude; model matching applies explicit Calzetti A1500 to the quoted attenuated magnitude. Metal lines are detected; He II does not uniquely imply Pop III.

records.component: off-center NE He II clump; IFU 0.24 x 0.24 arcsec
records.mu_provenance: 2024 unlensed-field analysis assumption; later Hebe mu=1.42 is not retroactively mixed into this record
records.dust_treatment: No dust correction, as in the original paper
records.muv_corrections: no host UV assigned to clump
records.notes: He II grating redshift 10.600, host systemic redshift 10.603. Component is offset by approximately 0.6 arcsec. No whole-host MUV matching.

records.component: extended He II region including clump; IFU 0.48 x 0.60 arcsec
records.muv_corrections: no host UV assigned to extended region
records.notes: Alternative aperture of the same system, not an independent object; contains emission closer to GN-z11 that may have another ionizing source.

records.component: MSA offset extraction 0.20 x 0.20 arcsec, PA 19.9 degrees
records.muv_corrections: no host UV assigned to aperture
records.notes: 3.7-sigma prism feature; absolute flux calibration and aperture/PSF corrections uncertain. Archived, not averaged with IFU measurements.
